scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:extension
scripts.test:extension: node engine.test.mjs && node segment.test.mjs && node ort-trap.test.mjs && node gpu.test.mjs && node concurrency.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser:extension && npm run test:browser:web
scripts.test:browser:extension: node browser/run.mjs --out /tmp/gyt-browser/good && node browser/run.mjs --bad-boxes --out /tmp/gyt-browser/bad-boxes && node browser/run.mjs --segmenter /tmp/gyt-fake-seg.onnx --out /tmp/gyt-browser/segmented && node browser/run.mjs --gpu --require-gpu --out /tmp/gyt-browser/gpu
scripts.demo: python3 make-demo-page.py fixtures && python3 make-pages.py fixtures 12
